name: SeerrNG
longDescription:
SeerrNG is a self-hosted request and discovery application for Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby.

It supports movie, TV, music, ebook, and audiobook requests and connects approved requests to Radarr, Sonarr, Lidarr, and Bookshelf or Readarr-compatible services.
description: Self-hosted media requests and discovery across movies, TV, music, and books.
